statement: Ty^op is neither total nor exact over every nonzero ring; cofinal type sequences are exactly those with unbounded run numbers; E_t to the sequential Cat colimit is always a weak equivalence, and the uniform other leg is governed by comma contractibility.
depends_on: TOTAL_EXACT_2 C.40; INDLOCAL C.21,C.23; PATHS A.2, all audited
notes: The compressed T1=Z step is written out; finite type checks are independent.

statement: For every pair r<=s in the reachability preorder R, the full subcategory of Ty on r<=tau<=s is weakly contractible.
depends_on: Moment-body ball model; relative simplex-complement lemma; Hirschhorn 15.10.4 and 19.9.1
notes: Includes empty types and equal one-sign endpoint types.

statement: For every F:Ty^op to Cat, conditions 2F, DESC, and LOC are equivalent, including the objectwise weak-equivalence zigzags permitted in 2F.
depends_on: B.2; audited PATHS C.P1–C.P2; explicit strictification
notes: Coherent descent is distinguished from equality of parallel maps in an ordinary homotopy category.

statement: F satisfies the all-cofinal-sequence comparison D iff its finite-subset extension F^omega sends every map of countable colored linear orders with unbounded alternation to a weak equivalence; equivalently both inclusions F^omega(L) to F^omega(L+J) from F^omega(J) are weak equivalences for every L.
depends_on: B.1; finite presentability; two explicit comma contractions; homotopy Kan extension
notes: Necessary and sufficient condition contains no quantified choice of sequence; identifies the actual canonical roof and includes noninjective transitions.

statement: The comparison BE_t to B integral F is the sequential homotopy colimit of the local-fibre units, in the homotopy category of arrows; LOC implies D.
depends_on: B.1; tail finality; natural homotopy left Kan units
notes: Lead5(b) is interpreted coherently, not as an untyped equality of strict Cat diagrams.

statement: D does not imply LOC, DESC, or 2F, even for set presheaves: S(w)=C(++,w) on run number<=1 and S(w)=1 on larger run number has this property.
depends_on: B.3; B.5; explicit functor and initial tail
notes: All functor laws in the stated finite search are independently checked; the tail argument proves every sequence.

statement: D1 does not imply D, even for the finitely presented set diagram S=C(+-, -) coproduct over image(C(+-+-, -)) with 1; dense alternating orders give a successful sequence, whereas the standard alternating order gives a failed one.
depends_on: Two functorial amalgam contractions; explicit image quotient; dense and discrete countable orders
notes: The global element category is contractible; the bad sequential colimit has infinitely many components.

statement: The complete implication order is 2F iff DESC iff LOC implies D implies D1, with neither last implication reversible, both in Cat diagrams and set presheaves; in sets the first three mean factorization through R^op, and D is exactly the two-inclusion bijection test.
notes: Includes the precise contractible-component indexing by each sequential set colimit and the empty presheaf.

statement: For a strict type 2-action the ordinary Grothendieck construction to the fibred 2-Grothendieck construction, and both arrows of each sequential comparison roof, are weak equivalences in the dimension-two Thomason structure of 317.
depends_on: B.1; B.3; Cegarra–Heredia Theorem5.1; Ara–Maltsiniotis Theorem6.27; 317 convention audited
notes: The actual strict 2-functors and cells are specified; no Lean execution is claimed.

statement: The VII comparison is governed exactly by B.4; full path diagrams always pass, arbitrary diagrams can fail, and one sequence is insufficient; the component assertion remains true under the literal homotopy hypothesis at ms.99.
notes: Corrects the ms.112 warning in its actual full-path context while preserving the general-base counterexample at109.

statement: For every n>=1, right End_Delta([n])-acts are equivalent to n-truncated simplicial sets and hence to simplicial sets of dimension<=n; every act is K_n uniquely up to isomorphism, with finiteness equivalent to finitely many nondegenerate simplices.
depends_on: Explicit idempotent splitting and simplicial skeleton
notes: All finite and infinite acts are included.

statement: For every n>=1 and every simplicial K of dimension<=n, M_n/K_n to Delta_<=n/K is homotopy final and its classifying space is weakly equivalent to |K|.
depends_on: E.1; truncated simplex bar; cell-attachment induction
notes: Does not discard degenerate simplices; infinite K follows from finite-chain support.

statement: Lead4(a)'s further functor to the category of nondegenerate simplices is false in general for n>=2: Delta[2]/boundary gives incompatible face factorizations and homology; it is valid for free degeneracy completions and for n=1.
notes: The original PRETOT A.4 has its needed free-degeneracy hypothesis and is not refuted.

statement: For all finite or infinite right M_n-acts H=K_n, H is totally W_Z-aspherical iff |K| is acyclic iff Z[H] is projective and M_n/H is nonempty connected; H is totally W_infty-aspherical iff |K| is weakly contractible.
depends_on: E.1–E.2; truncated Dold–Kan; Tor bar; final-map fundamental-group surjection
notes: Restricted actions are kept distinct from arbitrary actions on the element category.

statement: For finite total W_Z M_n-acts the possible groups are: trivial for n=1; groups with a finite balanced presentation and trivial abelianization for n=2; finitely presented superperfect groups for n>=3. Without finiteness replace the n=2 condition by a presentation with exponent-sum map an isomorphism of free abelian groups, and n>=3 by all small superperfect groups.
depends_on: E.1–E.4; Hopf sequence; explicit dimension-preserving face-poset mapping cylinder
notes: All necessities and realizations are proved; the infinite n=2 criterion is stronger than equality of generator and relator cardinals.

statement: Filtered, exact, total, and quasi-filtered connected categories form four strict classes, witnessed successively by Delta_inj, C_delta, and repaired K*; all higher Q levels are distinct and their intersection is totality.
notes: Free-monoid comparisons hold for every exact index, so they do not detect filteredness.

statement: Totality of a presheaf does not imply totality of its category of elements, for W_infty, W_Z, or W_n with n>=2; a five-element right act over the three-element M_1 is an explicit counterexample. The forward implication holds for every fundamental localizer.
depends_on: E.2; E.4; five-element act; double-cosieve action
notes: Complete monoid and action tables and integral H1=Z of the double are independently checked.

statement: The consolidated manuscript corrections distinguish all localizers and scopes at II36ter, XII93–114, VII99–115, XV128–137, and XVI7–16/99–113; strict and total functors compose, with the sieve answers depending on the localizer.
depends_on: A–G; explicit coend/collage verification of PRETOT B.4 and TOTASPH F.9
notes: The edition note at XV133bis and the target typo at133quinquies are distinguished from mathematical corrections.
